assessments.rationale: Using a recycled PC/ABS blend directly supports the use of secondary raw materials to reduce resource dependency as emphasized on Page 2 [Parameter (h)]. Furthermore, Page 80 [Parameter (t)] mandates lightweight design through the 'use of lower density or high-strength materials... with regard to material savings, recycling and other circularity aspects'. A monomaterial recycled plastic housing optimizes the material footprint [Parameter (o)] and ensures high recyclability at end-of-life [Parameter (d)].
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase (the recycled blend may exhibit lower impact resistance and drop durability compared to virgin glass-fiber reinforced polyamide, potentially shortening the product's operational lifetime).

options_evaluated: Standardized threaded fasteners with metal inserts
assessments.recommendation: Standardized threaded fasteners with metal inserts
assessments.rationale: Page 79 (b) highlights the need for 'ease of non-destructive disassembly and re-assembly' and 'compatibility with commonly available tools' [Parameter (d)]. Avoiding chemical adhesives or permanent welding prevents contamination of the plastic during recycling, aligning with Page 35 [Parameter (f)] where substances must not make the 'recycling process more complicated, costly, environmentally impactful, or energy- or resource-demanding'.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (increases assembly complexity, part count, and initial production costs compared to rapid ultrasonic welding).

options_evaluated: Brushless DC motor with separable neodymium magnets
Brushed DC motor with ferrite magnets
assessments.recommendation: Brushless DC motor with separable neodymium magnets
assessments.rationale: Page 80 [Parameter (t)] highlights lightweight design through the 'integration of functions within the material or into a single product component' to reduce weight and material footprint [Parameter (o)]. While neodymium is a critical raw material, Page 2 stresses the 'need for a secure supply of raw materials'. Designing the motor so that magnets are easily separable facilitates high-value recycling [Parameter (d)] as detailed in Page 79 (b) 'ease of non-destructive disassembly'.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (requires highly precise assembly and complex electronic drive integration, increasing manufacturing stage resource demands).

options_evaluated: Active fan cooling with housing vents
Passive cooling via integrated recycled aluminum heatsink
assessments.recommendation: Passive cooling via integrated recycled aluminum heatsink
assessments.rationale: Page 80 [Parameter (t)] promotes 'integration of functions within the material or into a single product component' to achieve lightweight design and reduce material footprint [Parameter (o)]. Utilizing recycled aluminum supports Page 2's focus on 'recycling and the use of secondary raw materials' [Parameter (h)] while avoiding extra active components.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase (the external housing may experience higher localized temperatures during intensive use, potentially impacting user comfort).

assessments.rationale: Page 79 (b) and (c) prioritize 'ease of repair and maintenance' and 'ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing and refurbishment' through 'modularity', 'use of standard components', and 'ease of non-destructive disassembly' [Parameter (k), (d)]. A modular architecture allows individual worn components to be replaced, minimizing the overall material footprint [Parameter (o)] and environmental footprint [Parameter (m)].
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Distribution and Logistics (modular connectors and internal housing walls increase the overall weight and volume [Parameter (j)] of the product, slightly reducing transport efficiency).

options_evaluated: Removable cylindrical Li-ion battery pack with standardized interface
assessments.recommendation: Removable cylindrical Li-ion battery pack with standardized interface
assessments.rationale: Page 9 and Page 35 [Parameter (f)] call for minimizing 'substances of concern' that 'make the reuse, or recycling process more complicated, costly, environmentally impactful'. Page 79 (b) mandates 'ease of non-destructive disassembly' to allow battery recovery [Parameter (d)], reducing the environmental footprint [Parameter (m)] and ensuring safe handling of hazardous waste (Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase (increases the physical volume and weight [Parameter (j)] of the tool, reducing ergonomic handling compared to an integrated pouch cell).
